title: Palace: the general and the advisor never leave it
rationale: The general on d2 may step to d3 and e2 but not to c2, which is one file outside the palace; the advisor on d1 may step diagonally to e2 but not to c2, outside it, and not to e1, which is inside the palace but not a diagonal. Confinement and step shape are two rules and this position separates them.
